layout_note: The NT lectionary 'A Table of the Epistles and Gospels, after the Romane vse, vpon Sundaies, Holidaies...' occupying jp2-S08 pp773-776(top). TWO columns per page, read left column fully then right column. Each row = a feast/occasion (roman, left) paired with its Epistle and Gospel PAGE references into this 1582 NT (italic/roman, right): 'Ep. NNN.' + 'Goſp. NNN.' (also 'goſp.'/'Goſ.'/'Go.' as printed), sometimes with a verse span ('v. X. vnto Y', 'verſ. X to the Y'). STRUCTURE: p773 opens with an ornament band + 8-line display title + italic sub-title 'Vpon Sundaies, Imber Daies, and other Feries.' + a drop-cap 'T'; a temporal cycle (Advent->Pentecost Sundays) runs to mid-p775; then italic sub-headings partition the rest: 'For Saincts and Feſtiual daies, peculiar and proper' (sanctoral), 'For Saincts generally and in common' (commons), 'In votiue Maſſes...' (votive), 'In Maſſes of Requiem.' (final). The Table ENDS on p776 after the Requiem reference block, followed by a horizontal rule and the display title 'AN AMPLE AND PARTICVLAR TABLE' (= the next matter-book, matter-nt-ample-and-particular-table). Running headers: p773 none (section opener); p774 'EPISTLES AND GOSPELS.'; p775 'A TABLE OF'; p776 'EPIST. AND GOSPELS.'. Leaves unnumbered; quire signatures 'Bbb bb ij' (p774 foot) and 'Bbbbb iij' (p776 foot). Body rows are LOGICAL table entries (the table's natural scoring grain), not physical display lines; multi-line entries are de-hyphenated into one row. On p773 the last left-column entry's Gospel ref '141. verſe 33 vnto 41.' physically overflows to the top of the right column and is folded back into that entry.

uncertain.note: The Epistle/Gospel entries are PAGE references into the 1582 NT; numerals read from legible high-res bands but a handful sit at the trimmed right edge or under foxing. Per §markers these references are chapter-level apparatus; individual digits were read but not each independently re-zoom-verified. Notable: p774R 'The 5 Sund.' Goſp.12 sits at the trimmed edge; p773R 2nd & 3rd Sunday after Epiphanie both reference Ep.413 (as printed — consecutive Rom.12 pericopes, plausible).
The abbreviation for Gospel is set inconsistently (cap 'Goſp.' vs lowercase 'goſp.', and clipped 'Goſ.'/'Go.'); transcribed per line as seen, but case on the smallest instances is approximate.

method: Jarvis main-thread visual-multimodal transcription (no sub-agents, per Sir's directive). Rendered jp2-S08 pages 773-776 at native ~400 DPI via jp2_page.py, then read each page in 3-5 high-res LANCZOS column-bands (rband.py) top-to-bottom, with targeted crops for the p773 display title, the p773 final left entry, and both p775 column tails. VALIDATIONS: (1) Localization - display title 'A TABLE OF THE EPISTLES AND GOSPELS' + content confirm this is the NT lectionary; the following section 'AN AMPLE AND PARTICVLAR TABLE' bounds its end on p776. (2) Identity - jp2-S08 = the 1582 Rhemes NT hi-res set, the correct source for the 1582 NT back matter. (3) Placement - pp773-776, running headers + quire signatures recorded; leaves unnumbered. (4) Completeness - whole section transcribed across all 4 pages incl. both columns; ends at 'In Maſſes of Requiem' reference block before the rule. Diplomatic per GUIDELINES.md: long-ſ glyph-driven; w vs vv per-instance stroke connectivity (display VV gapped e.g. Tvvelfth/VVHITSVNDAY vs connected w e.g. 'Twelfth eue', 'warre', 'Bartholomew'); macrons preserved (Aduēt, Mūday, benedictiō, Cōmemoration, Inuentiō); u/v & i/j as printed; abbreviations kept. No external text used as a spelling oracle.
confidence: High on occasion/feast labels and headings (the priority-#1 text): every row read from a legible band, long-ſ and u/v/i/j and w/vv adjudicated per glyph. Medium on the Epistle/Gospel PAGE numerals (apparatus references) - read from the bands but a few sit at the trimmed edge or under foxing; flagged in uncertain[]. Body granularity is logical table-rows, not physical lines (appropriate for a reference table; noted in layout_note).
glyph_regime_resolved: Mixed. Roman occasion labels + italic Latin rubrics (In Cathedra S. Petri Romæ; In maioribus Litaniis; In votiue Maſſes...) + italic sub-headings. w/vv BOTH present and decided per glyph: gapped VV in display/word-initial caps (Tvvelfth, VVHITSVNDAY, Vveneſday, Vvhitſun, ALHALOVVES) and in a few italic/lowercase sorts (Lovv, Levvis, Matthevves, vvomen, Vvidovves, vvhich, vvithin), but connected real w elsewhere (Twelfth eue, warre, Bartholomew, whitſun-). long-ſ glyph-driven. glyph_counts.long_s_transcribed = 356.
